title: Navigating Currency Conversions on World Blue
summary: This document explains how to convert currencies on World Blue, including a $100 minimum conversion amount and support for 35 currencies. It states quotes include a 1.5% low-margin markup over the prevailing wholesale rate and that the trade ticket shows the effective rate and converted amount before submission.
